name: mole
description: Digs up UI bugs before your users do: checks your running app against your DESIGN.md and modern design practice, points every defect at its file:line, and shows a live panel while it works.

show_panel.title: Show the Mole panel
show_panel.description: Open a browser window with the live Mole panel whenever Claude runs a check (turn off for silent, faster checks).

claude_judge.title: Claude second opinion
claude_judge.description: Only used together with a Jev key, for the findings Jev is unsure about. login = your own Claude Code login (no key needed); api-key = the Anthropic API key below; off = send them to a person.

typesafe_api_key.title: Jev key (optional)
typesafe_api_key.description: TypeSafe API key for Jev, the fast cheap first judge. Leave empty to run the free deterministic checks only. Stored in your OS keychain.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Only needed if Claude second opinion is set to api-key. Stored in your OS keychain.
